description.name: MixPay
description.tagline: Accept cryptocurrency payments in WHMCS through MixPay Checkout.
description.long: A third-party payment gateway for WHMCS that creates MixPay checkout sessions, redirects customers to MixPay to complete payment, and processes asynchronous payment callbacks to credit WHMCS invoices.
features: MixPay transaction history in the WHMCS admin area
